data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002's contradiction premise—that standardized auto-scaling creates hidden correlations synchronizing failures—is asserted without evidence or mechanism. The problem explicitly asks to identify what evidence would distinguish truly independent failures from merely-uncorrelated-until-shared-cause failures. SRC_002 names one possible coupling (auto-scaling algorithms) but provides no diagnostic evidence or test that would reveal whether the resulting correlations are genuine synchronization vs. coincidental, so it fails the evidence-identification requirement.
